extraction.Name: Annie Moran Dubray
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, the folks brought it home from the postoffice and I did not say anything about it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: first mortgaged it to Peters Trust Company for $1500 and later sold it to Renwick Cross for three lots and a house in the town of Mission, S. D., and he assumed the mortgage
extraction.Buyer: Renwick Cross for three lots and a house in the town of Mission, S. D.
extraction.NOTES: Has six children; husband and she support them by farming etc.; husband made the deal for the sale; states 'I think I would be better off if I had never received this patent'; formerly Annie Moran; document notarized June 6, 1929 by Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32; in good health
